mapper.update: UPDATE message_recovery r SET state='RESOLVED',resolved_at=#{now},next_attempt_at=NULL, lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now},updated_by_type='SERVICE',updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND recovery_id=#{id} AND state='REPLAYING' AND last_replay_correlation_id=#{correlation} AND next_attempt_at=#{lease} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inbox_message i WHERE i.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND i.inbox_id=r.source_record_id AND i.status IN ('PROCESSED','REJECTED'))
mapper.select:
SELECT recovery_id,direction,source_record_id,business_intent_key,state,attempt_count,next_attempt_at,last_error_code,last_error_summary,dead_lettered_at,recovery_required_at,replay_count,last_replayed_at,last_replayed_by_type,last_replayed_by_id,last_replay_reason,last_replay_correlation_id,resolved_at,lock_version,created_at,updated_at FROM message_recovery WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND recovery_id=#{id}
FOR UPDATE

SELECT inbox_id,message_id,business_intent_key,contract_ref,contract_version,body_bytes,body_sha256,correlation_id,causation_id,occurred_at,status,lock_version FROM inbox_message WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND inbox_id=#{id}
FOR UPDATE

SELECT o.outbox_id,o.contract_ref,o.contract_version,o.aggregate_id,o.correlation_id,o.status,o.lock_version,l.status AS link_status,COALESCE(l.lock_version,0) AS link_version FROM outbox_event o LEFT JOIN incident_ticket_link l ON l.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND l.incident_id=o.aggregate_id WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND o.outbox_id=#{id}
FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status='PENDING',attempt_count=0,next_attempt_at=#{now},locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL,last_error_code=NULL,broker_confirmed_at=NULL,lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now},updated_by_type='SERVICE' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND outbox_id=#{outboxId} AND status='RECOVERY_REQUIRED' AND lock_version=#{version}

UPDATE incident_ticket_link SET status='REQUESTED',recovery_required_at=NULL,recovery_reason_code=NULL,lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now},updated_by_type='SERVICE' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND incident_id=#{incidentId} AND status='RECOVERY_REQUIRED' AND lock_version=#{linkVersion}

UPDATE message_recovery SET state='REPLAYING',next_attempt_at=#{leaseUntil},replay_count=replay_count+1,last_replayed_at=#{now},last_replayed_by_type='USER',last_replayed_by_id=#{actor},last_replay_reason=#{reason},last_replay_correlation_id=#{corr},lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now},updated_by_type='USER',updated_by_id=#{actor} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND recovery_id=#{id} AND direction=#{direction} AND source_record_id=#{source} AND state='OPEN' AND lock_version=#{version}

UPDATE message_recovery SET state='OPEN',next_attempt_at=NULL,last_error_code=#{error},last_error_summary='Controlled same-path replay did not reach a local terminal result.',lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now},updated_by_type='SERVICE' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND recovery_id=#{id} AND state='REPLAYING' AND last_replay_correlation_id=#{corr} AND next_attempt_at=#{leaseUntil}
mapper.select: SELECT action_code,target_id,outcome,actor_type,actor_id,reason,error_code,correlation_id,causation_id FROM audit_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND audit_id=#{id}
